issue_title: Search results appear empty in the desktop UI after a backend update
issue_body: The backend still finds matches, but the list does not render. Preserve the documented search result shape. The frontend normaliser src/api/search.ts normalizeSearchResult(raw) must return an object shaped { id, title, path, snippet, score }, tolerating both the current and the older backend field names. The Rust search result must serialise with exactly the keys id, title, path, snippet, score. Result ordering must stay deterministic.
expected_behavior: Rust search results serialise to id, title, path, snippet, score.
normalizeSearchResult maps both current and older backend shapes to the canonical object.
An empty result set normalises to an empty list.
expected_failure_summary: The Rust SearchResult serialises snippet under a renamed JSON key (preview), and the TypeScript normaliser was narrowed to read only the current key names, so canonical { id, title, path, snippet, score } is no longer produced on either side and the UI list renders empty.
task_author_notes: Restore the snippet field to serialise under the key snippet (remove the serde rename), and restore the older-shape fallbacks in normalizeSearchResult so docId/name/location/preview/rank still map. Both sides must agree on the canonical shape.
